item.title: Osvrt: Tuesday Brings Higher Temperatures Across Bulgaria
item.description: Bulgaria will see sunny and warmer weather on Tuesday before rain, stronger winds and a drop in temperatures arrive later in the week, according to the forecast. Temperatures today will be higher than yesterday in most parts of the country, with highs ranging from 16°C in northeastern Bulgaria to 22°C in the northwest.
